name: Budhaditya Sengupta
comment: The small outlet is located just the lane next to my apartment. Tried their momo for the first time and it was really so good. They even put a liver piece in the soup which was an add on. I will definitely visit again.

name: Mr Moghli
comment: Momo was cold from inside and bland. Hair in soup. Just cheap momos if you prefer money before your health go ahead.
ownerResponse: We are really sorry to hear that sir. We ensure that you will get better service in future. Please feel free to contact us at 9079937257.

name: Sayan Ganguly
comment: I bought chicken momos and chilli chicken from them. Both of them were delicious and taste was exquisite.

name: Priya Sharma
comment: Ordered one plate chicken momo it's a beautiful and delicious 😋 and soft cooking।

name: Rahul Das
comment: Excellent food, darjeeling vibe! Love the ambiance and the momos are heavenly.

name: Ananya Roy
comment: Ordered 2 plates of momo, it was too good.. loved the taste.. Will definitely order again!
